Don't expect [[Yuimo the Mime]] to tell you anything, he only plays [[emote]]s. The young [[Musako Tu’ro|Musako]] is very fond of him.
Together with her and her mother [[Tanrieo Tu’ro|Tanrieo]] he belongs to a little [[Wajjun Bazaar#Dialogue between Musako Tu’ro, Tanrieo Tu’ro and Yuimo the Mime|sketch]]. They seem to appear only during random occasions.

== Notes ==
